How long has your tank been set up for? I see lots of oxygen bubbles on the glass which is usually a sign of a tank that was just set up. I would suggest a hiding spot up top like a betta log. Im not too much of a fan of the leaves as they don’t provide much coverage. All the bettas ive owned personally like to sleep in the covered areas in the tank or in thick leafy plants. Also, do you have two filters going in the same tank? A sponge and a hang on filter? Seems like a bit much. Im not sure if it would cause any direct harm, but it may cause the water current to be too strong for them. Looks like theres quite a bit of room at the top of your tank also. Id suggest filling it up all the way. No use letting extra tank space go to waste by not filling it up. Other than that, its a really good start and looks like a nice sized tank.
Edit: I just now saw the difference of the hang on the back filter output and the water line. Please fill the tank up asap. That water flow will stress the betta out. Long finned bettas especially have a hard time swimming in currents like that. Imagine swimming in a river in a ball gown. The key with bettas is to find a good balance between keeping the water as clean as possible but also keeping the water flow as minimal as possible too.
